new_findings.fact: Each active/cache.dat state entry exports full attributes, not just name and size. Cached attributes can be returned without loading the per-torrent state.
new_findings.consequence: Aggregate skipped-byte facts and dndflags are available in the existing single startup cache read when present and well formed.

new_findings.fact: On real-state fixup, cached attributes replace newly loaded state attributes. Cached size is returned directly only when>0; zero/missing forces original fixup.
new_findings.consequence: Do not overwrite retained cache facts with older .dat attributes. Cache-only raw zero is not a resolved original size without selected geometry or an explicitly separate native raw-snapshot policy.

new_findings.fact: DND flags are nested in attributes.parameters. parameterExists distinguishes absent flags from explicitly present0. skipfss defaults-1; absent skipbdl returns0. Long attribute wrong types can throw; malformed parameter values can log and return0.
new_findings.consequence: A typed native parser must retain field presence/type diagnostics instead of silently treating every missing or malformed input as a successful zero.

new_findings.fact: Saved per-file downloaded bytes are attributes.filedownloaded.downloaded, a List of Long in original file index order.
new_findings.consequence: No payload stat/read is required to obtain a saved per-file counter; it still needs geometry/index/range/provenance validation before publishing a metric.

new_findings.fact: Original loadFileDownloaded loads only min(fileCount,listLength), leaves other skeleton counters at Java default0, and may retain a prefix after a type fault. File policy decode and skeleton priority changes can calculate/write skipped caches.
new_findings.consequence: Partial-list/default recovery and callback/write effects are source-only boundaries. A conservative native selected-row publication requires an exact valid indexed list or stays unknown; never invoke the skeleton to fill gaps.

new_findings.fact: Public isDownloadComplete(false) returns assumedComplete; its true branch calls the controller. Re-evaluating assumed mode can write state/times and inspect actual file length/mtime.
new_findings.consequence: A pure controller completion candidate is distinct from the full public assumed-state lifecycle; do not call requestAssumedCompleteMode or claim its effects in a saved projection.

new_findings.fact: Metadata-download status comes from attributes.flags bit0x200. The DND Always In Incomplete view setting defaultsfalse, but its actual saved/configured value changes which public completion branch MyTorrents requests.
new_findings.consequence: Metadata Size/Remaining suppression and pane membership need these separate inputs. cache.dp is discard-pieces metadata, not downloaded bytes or completion.

new_findings.fact: readLibrarySource already owns the immutable decoded cacheDocument once, but readStateCache currently extracts only displayname from attributes and readLibraryView discards the backing cache ownership.
new_findings.consequence: Reuse one-pass parsing/indexing or add fixed owned DND facts to CachedTorrent; do not reread cache per row or scan every .dat at startup.

new_findings.fact: Read-only TorrentStateStore.load and queryTorrent read .dat/.bak and verify metadata identity. Only beginUpdate hydrates cached attributes, and that path writes state/cache. queryTorrent returns file length/policy/padding but no downloaded field.
new_findings.consequence: Never use beginUpdate/save for read-only progress. Add explicit immutable cache-attribute precedence to any selected-row enrichment rather than assuming load already matches original wrapper behavior.

pure_projection_proposal.input: Owned fixed SavedDndFacts with optional raw T/C/K/B/dndFlags/torrentFlags, attributes/parameters presence and fixed type-status bits; immutable identity/source/provenance stamp supplied by caller. A read-only Node extractor returns owned facts without retaining borrowed pointers.
pure_projection_proposal.output: Owned SavedDndProjection with independent Metric<int64> selectedBytes/remainingBytes, Metric<int32> percentThousandths, cached hasDnd/selectedComplete facts, controller-no-DM completion candidates and fixed bounded diagnostics. Each Metric carries known/default-derived/unknown-invalid reason and source stamp; never expose heap callback or writer authority.

limits.policy: Only lower limits; honor existing bounded parser/gzip/file/geometry caps. Check counts and checked-size sums before allocating/walking. Do not add unbounded strings, recursive scans or per-row copies of entire documents.

independent_fields: Selected size can be known when full completed bytes are absent.
S==0 causes the original Stats percent1000 without reading remaining; a known selected percent does not imply controller or pane completion.
Raw full bytes stay separate from selected bytes; never overwrite geometry used by Files/transfer ownership.
Retain contradictory saved flags/counters as separate evidence with diagnostics rather than force them into a fabricated consistent state.

candidate_saved_no_disk_math.definitions: T=resolved full size,C=saved full completed,K=resolved skipped total,B=saved/default-derived skipped completed.
candidate_saved_no_disk_math.percent: S==0 ->1000; S<0 ->0; otherwise Java float32 division of wrap64(S-Q) by S, float32 multiply1000, Java float-to-int truncation/saturation; change result1000 to999 if Q>0, else clamp negative to0. Source has no generic upper clamp.
candidate_saved_no_disk_math.eligibility: This is the saved/no-DiskManager getter branch only. Full live delegation/checking/state transitions are separate. A future native invalid-input/overflow admission policy must be frozen separately from exact raw Java arithmetic and cannot receive unearned equality credit.

pure_projection_proposal.completion: For known present dndFlags, no-DM Controller(false) uses full remaining==0 when HASDND is false, else cached COMPLETE_NO_DND. Controller(true) returnsfalse for HASDND in this no-READY-DM path. Public DMImpl(false) instead returns assumedComplete. Name the pure candidate honestly; full pane parity remains OPEN until source/owner/config integration gates pass.
pure_projection_proposal.unknown_policy: No attributes/malformed maps/types, unresolved/negative K, invalid/missing C and mismatched identities yield affected-field unknown/diagnostic. Missing B only in a present valid map uses explicit source default0; missing K records source default-1 and remains unresolved. Preserve raw facts and fixed default provenance; no invented raw0 or100%.

startup_and_selected_row_architecture: Keep startup to the existing downloads.config read plus single active/cache.dat read; no per-torrent .dat opens, glob, stat payload, directory walk, engine session or peer lookup.

Extract fixed DND facts in the existing one-pass state-cache parse, keeping matching hash/last-entry behavior. Alternatively index readLibrarySource.cacheDocument once and retain its shared immutable owner, never an unowned Node pointer.
Rows with missing aggregates render explicit unknown selected metrics. The library remains usable; do not schedule an automatic N-file fallback for100000 rows.

For one explicitly requested selected row, reuse current safe metadata .dat/.bak load, identity validation, originalLayout and originalFilePolicy. These are metadata-only reads; no beginUpdate, save, payload inspection or link/path resolution.

Apply cached attributes as effective source if present, matching original wrapper precedence. If cache is unavailable, a separately tagged per-torrent attribute snapshot may supply fallback facts; never mix older .dat attrs into a newer cache snapshot silently.

Require exact per-file downloaded count and matching original index geometry for a conservative native per-file metric; original partial/min-length/default0 behavior is characterized separately with zero native equality credit.

Bind selected request/result to current library revision/hash/source row and source provenance. For saved inventory priorities, retain one immutable inventory snapshot or compare a retained whole-inventory digest before using a later reread; owner generation alone does not detect external profile edits.

Keep retained documents bounded/shared once or retain compact fixed facts; avoid one large backing document copy per row. Selected enrichment cache should be bounded and invalidated by a new authoritative snapshot.

Later append explicit selected metrics to UI snapshot/Details fields and update the affected sort/filter roles with existing generation/target guards; hidden/closed MyTorrents must not initiate detail reads or be reopened by late results. No silent substitution into existing full-byte fields.

synthetic_native_policy: Hand-encoded cache attributes with explicit/missing/wrong-type fields, duplicate cache identities and unknown properties; preserve raw document and existing parser duplicate-dictionary-key policy.
Partial-known metrics: known S with unknown C/B; zero selected size; present flags0/1/2/3/highbits; metadata flag bit0x200; view preference true/false/missing provenance.

Skipped files already downloaded, all skipped/none skipped, C<B, inconsistent cached flags versus percent, near-long/float precision boundaries; fix native invalid/overflow policy before expected assertions.

Selected geometry validation: exact count/order, zero-length/padding/v1-v2 qualified layouts, unsupported link/path rules stay errors, short/long/type-fault downloaded lists stay unknown with no implicit zero-fill.

Lifetime/immutability: owned facts outlive source documents; shared retained cache not copied per row; caps lowered/raised rejection, zero per-torrent reads at startup, exactly selected metadata reads on demand, no save/payload stat/callback access.

UI future tests: numeric selected sorting, source-independent completion facts, pane migration only under approved completion policy, stale revision/late details/hidden tab guards, full geometry fields unchanged.
